text: Activists break into a Cambridge laboratory and free a chimpanzee [infected with rage|origin|monsters people made], and within seconds [the virus leaps to them|rules|it passes to others]. Twenty-eight days later, bicycle courier Jim wakes from a coma in a deserted London hospital and [walks the empty streets|images|buildings and public places] until the infected give chase. With survivors Selena, Frank and his daughter Hannah, he follows a radio promise of salvation to a blockade near Manchester, where soldiers under Major West [keep a sanctuary that hides a darker purpose|threat|the powerful and their systems].
